limits: Six designs; all five adapter designs receive rates1/2 and two fresh seeds; the no-adapter AdaLN control trains once per seed, giving22 full30k runs.
Block/Hadamard and square diagonal/lowrank share additive feature placement before the same MLP projection; rectangular DPLR is a contextual reference with different placement/subspace constraints.
Square lowrank uses1.21M adapter parameters and block1.15M; diagonal s96 uses396032 and Hadamard400128, with paired96-output coefficient heads. These are approximate parameter, not FLOP, matches.
Common base/AdaLN, non-affine norms, class/time broadcast and zero-delta initialization remain; no token self-conditioning or sequence context.

Generator width32 per factor/diagonal and transform rank8 fixed, except the budget-control diagonal uses96; block size16; Hadamard diagonals have no positivity, gain cap or learned orthogonality constraint.

Initial Hadamard internal mixing is orthogonal before the zero output diagonal; the trained transform need not preserve variance. Square/rectangular operators have different Jacobians and coordinate gauges.
Actual optimizer group ownership and schedule rates are audited; global LR8e-4, adapter multipliers1/2. No claim of optimal or function-update-matched rates.
All methods get the same quality/evaluation budget; report every final endpoint including finite poor quality. No automatic selection, checkpoint resume or grid expansion.
Primary final30k CFG2 FID; retain CFG1, agreement, both seeds, same-square-placement contrasts and separately labeled cross-placement reference gaps.
Same reused research holdout and noise; two training seeds do not establish independent final-quality evidence.
FP32 fixed function probes report projected conditional branches; square probes include shared MLP-weight motion. Live BF16 rounding residuals are logged separately.
Source overlays only implement declared operators/integration/diagnostics. Historical data/evaluation/helper sources remain frozen.
No isolated speed benchmarks. Concurrent throughput and whole-training allocation are descriptive; Hadamard additions/casts/traffic are not included in matrix FLOPs.
No generic checkpoints, weights, official test, evaluator downloads, tensor-train/FFT, shared/nonlinear trunk, retrieval or LM launch.
